subject: Activation plan for additional teams / API keys (Crestview Health)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crestviewhealth.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, Sara Patel <sara.patel@crestviewhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion request — onboarding 3 additional teams / API keys

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Crestview is ready to move forward with enabling three new teams (PatientInsights, ClaimsAutomation, and ClinicalSearch) and two new mobile apps that will need their own API keys and scoped access. High-level asks:

- Can you confirm an estimated timeline for key provisioning and staged rollout?
- Any material change to pricing / committed capacity we should expect for +3 teams and +2 apps?
- We need a short SOW addendum that lists the additional deliverables and target dates so procurement can fast-track sign-off.

Procurement would like the SOW and cost delta this week if possible. I’ve cc'd Sara (IT procurement) to this thread.

Also, we have a list of the target app IDs — I can send that as a csv; would you prefer us to drop it here or share a Drive folder?

Appreciate the quick turnaround,

Liam O'Connor
Director, Platform Integrations
Crestview Health
liam.oconnor@crestviewhealth.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: ava_chen@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crestviewhealth.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@crestviewhealth.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — onboarding 3 additional teams / API keys

Hi Liam — great to hear you're ready to expand. We can support the three teams and two mobile apps without downtime; below is a proposed plan and what I need from your side to move forward.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Day 0 (kickoff): confirm app/team list + provide app IDs (you can upload the csv to the Drive link below)
- Day 1–2: generate scoped API keys and map to teams (we'll provide api-key-mapping.csv)
- Day 3–7: staged rollout to dev -> staging -> prod with canary traffic (rollout-checklist.xlsx attached)

Pricing/Capacity note:
- For the incremental volume you described, hosted usage remains within your current committed tier for the first 60 days. If sustained throughput across the new teams exceeds the current commit we’ll propose a modest commit uplift (~15%) or recommend adding a Dedicated burst pool depending on workload profile. I’ll loop in Monica to provide a formal delta estimate.

SOW addendum: attached is a short SOW draft (Crestview_MAAP-SOW-v2.pdf) capturing scope, dates, and acceptance criteria. Please review and flag any procurement-specific language. If that looks good we can route as a simple addendum to the existing MSA.

Next actions for us:
1) You share the app IDs (Drive link preferred).
2) Procurement confirms whether a signed addendum is sufficient or if they need a separate PO.
3) We'll queue key generation and assign owners for the rollout tasks.

Drive folder for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/crestview-rollout
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/1098

Thanks — looping Monica & Ben for pricing and sequencing.

— Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
From: ava_chen@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-31T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Expansion request — onboarding 3 additional teams / API keys

Team — forwarding the Crestview request. Key points: +3 teams, +2 mobile apps, procurement wants SOW and pricing this week. See Liam's original note below.

Pricing draft (Monica please confirm):
- Baseline: existing commit covers expected burst for first 30–60 days.
- If sustained 24/7 traffic above current token/day average: propose +15% committed capacity (monthly) OR recommend Dedicated burst pool priced at $Xk/month (TBD).
- One-time professional services for rollout coordination and key scoping: $4,000 (covers staging/QA support and on-call during canary weeks).

Operational steps & owners: 
- AVA: client kickoff, SOW updates, procurement liaison
- MONICA: run the pricing delta calculation & finalize addendum language (due EOD 2027-06-01)
- BEN: prepare api-key-mapping.csv and script for scoped key provisioning; target generate keys by 2027-06-04
- LAURA: confirm legal sign-off path for addendum and whether Crestview needs PO or DocuSign (I can jump on a quick legal sync)

Attachments added to the HubSpot deal: Crestview_MAAP-SOW-v2.pdf, rollout-checklist.xlsx (I also created a preliminary api-key-mapping.csv with placeholder app IDs — will replace once we get Crestview's csv).

Please reply with any changes. Also FYI: I recommend offering a 60-day monitoring window post-rollout to watch quality regressions; include it in the addendum.

On Mon, May 30, 2027 at 11:03 AM ava_chen@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi Liam — great to hear you're ready to expand. We can support the three teams and two mobile apps without downtime; below is a proposed plan and what I need from your side to move forward.
>

Thanks,
Ava
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crestviewhealth.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@crestviewhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — onboarding 3 additional teams / API keys

Ava — thanks for the clear plan.

We confirm the three teams and two apps. I uploaded the app list to your Drive folder (file: crestview_app_ids_may30.csv) and attached our procurement template to the same folder. Procurement prefers a short addendum to the MSA; they will not issue a PO as long as the addendum includes the schedule and acceptance criteria.

We are comfortable with the proposed 60-day monitoring window. Please proceed with final SOW addendum and the api-key mapping.

Target start for staged rollout: 2027-06-14 (our devs will be ready by then).

I’ve initiated an internal approval and will sign once DocuSign comes through. Putting Sara on the thread for any procurement questions.
